title: Qualified Chartered Accountant (Operations Manager)
description:
**Job Description – Qualified Chartered Accountant (Operations Manager)**
=========================================================================

**PREPCA | Pune (Baner) | Full-Time | Work from Office**

### **About PREPCA**

PREPCA is a leading mentorship platform for Chartered Accountancy aspirants across India, Nepal, and Dubai. With over half a decade of experience in the education sector, we have mentored more than 95,000 students and built a team of 100+ professionals dedicated to transforming CA education.

We are looking for a **Qualified Chartered Accountant to take up the role of Operations Manager**, managing end-to-end academic and operational activities at PREPCA.

### **Role Overview**

The Operations Manager will oversee academic quality and operational efficiency across CA Foundation, Intermediate, and Final levels.

The role combines academic content management, question paper setting and reviewing, academic audits, team management, student experience, and end-to-end operational coordination.

### **Key Roles & Responsibilities**

**1. Academic Management & Quality Control**

* Oversee academic activities across CA Foundation, Intermediate, and Final levels.
* Coordinate question paper setting, reviewing, and quality checks.
* Review academic content for accuracy, relevance, and alignment with ICAI standards.
* Conduct academic audits of recorded/live sessions and evaluate delivery quality.
* Coordinate with mentors and the academic team to maintain content and delivery standards.
* Identify academic gaps and implement improvements.

**2. End-to-End Operations Management**

* Manage daily operations across Mentorship Programs, Test Series, and Classes.
* Oversee the complete student journey, from onboarding to ongoing service delivery.
* Ensure smooth academic coordination and timely execution of operational activities.
* Identify operational challenges and take ownership of their resolution.

**3. Team Management & Leadership**

* Lead, monitor, and coordinate with the operations team.
* Allocate responsibilities, track performance, and ensure accountability.
* Train and guide team members to improve productivity and service quality.
* Handle escalations and ensure timely resolution of student concerns.

**4. Process Improvement & Reporting**

* Develop and implement SOPs to streamline academic and operational workflows.
* Monitor operational KPIs, performance metrics, and student satisfaction.
* Create and maintain dashboards for performance tracking and reporting.
* Identify bottlenecks and implement solutions to improve efficiency.

**5. Cross-functional Coordination**

* Work closely with Academic, Mentorship, Sales, and Operations teams.
* Ensure seamless coordination between academic delivery and student services.
* Drive timely execution of academic and operational initiatives.

### **Experience & Skills Required**

* **Must be a Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) with ICAI membership.**
* Strong understanding of CA Foundation, Intermediate, and Final examination patterns and syllabus.
* Knowledge of academic content development, question paper setting, reviewing, and quality audits.
* Good proficiency in MS Excel, including advanced Excel functions.
* Ability to create dashboards and analyse operational and academic data.
* Excellent communication skills in **English and Hindi**.
* Knowledge of additional regional languages will be an advantage.
* Strong team management, coordination, and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple responsibilities and take ownership of deliverables.
* Proactive approach with strong attention to detail.

### **Educational Qualification**

Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) – ICAI Member.

### **Compensation**

**Annual CTC: ₹4–8 LPA**, depending on relevant experience, skills, and interview performance.

### **Perks & Privileges**

* Health Insurance.
* Earned Leaves (as per company policy).
* Daily meditation sessions.
* Monthly learning, development, and fun activities.
* Employee recognition and reward programs.

**Job Description – Operations Team Leader**
============================================

**PREPCA | Pune (Baner) | Full-Time | Work from Office**

### **About PREPCA**

PREPCA is a leading mentorship platform for Chartered Accountancy aspirants across India, Nepal, and Dubai. With over half a decade of experience, 95,000+ students mentored, and a team of 100+ professionals, we are committed to simplifying CA preparation and helping students achieve their goals.

### **Role Overview**

We are looking for a **hands-on Operations Team Leader** to manage end-to-end operations across our Mentorship Programs, Test Series, and Classes.

The role involves managing the complete student journey, leading the operations team, ensuring seamless service delivery, resolving operational challenges, and driving student satisfaction.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* **End-to-End Operations:** Manage daily operations across Mentorship, Test Series, and Classes, from student onboarding to ongoing service delivery.
* **Student Experience:** Ensure student satisfaction, handle escalations, resolve complaints, and improve service quality.
* **Team Management:** Lead, train, and monitor the operations team, ensuring productivity and accountability.
* **Process Management:** Develop SOPs, streamline workflows, identify bottlenecks, and improve operational efficiency.
* **Cross-functional Coordination:** Coordinate with Sales, Academic, Faculty, and Mentorship teams to ensure smooth execution.
* **Performance Monitoring:** Track operational KPIs, student satisfaction, pending issues, and resolution timelines.

### **Experience & Skills Required**

* **2–5 years of experience in core operations and team management.**
* Strong hands-on experience in managing end-to-end operations and leading teams.
* Experience in Education, EdTech, or Education Services preferred.
* **CA education domain experience will be a major advantage.**
* Strong leadership, communication, coordination, and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency in Google Sheets, CRM tools, and operational reporting.
* Strong ownership mindset and ability to handle operational challenges independently.

### **Educational Qualification**

Graduation or Post-Graduation in any discipline.

### **Compensation**

**Annual CTC:** **4-6LPA, based on experience and interview performance.**

### **Perks & Privileges**

* Health Insurance.
* Earned Leaves (as per company policy).
* Daily meditation sessions.
